svg.title: Datum site analysis: Miami, Florida
svg.desc: Generated 2026-09-25T13:30:54.991Z. Sources listed in the attribution group. Coordinates 25.80116, -80.18906.

g.text: heights known for 214 of 258 buildings; levels known for 1. contours at 1 m. 3 FEMA flood polygons in frame

text.tspan: Walking speed 80 m per minute. Start node 1 m from the site point. Unreached streets in the fetch extent are faint.

text.tspan: SSURGO maps this as Urban land: the natural profile is disturbed or covered and no
hydrologic group is assigned.
A site specific geotechnical investigation is required before any foundation decision.

g.text: Land area 181,656 m2. Margins of error are stored with the estimates.
ASCE 7-22, RISK CATEGORY II, SITE CLASS D
Site class is the default, not measured

text.tspan: Site Class D and Risk Category II are defaults. A site specific geotechnical report is required to
confirm site class.
Moderate, 0.2 percent annual chance

g.text: ZONE CODES IN FRAME: AE, VE, X

text.tspan: Classified from the FEMA fields FLD_ZONE, ZONE_SUBTY, SFHA_TF, and STATIC_BFE. Verify the effective map
at msc.fema.gov before setting a finished floor elevation.
Overhang projection over glazing height is 1 / tan(summer solstice noon altitude): geometry only, no site
obstructions.

g.text: Band: mean daily minimum to maximum. Tick: monthly mean. Dashed: relative humidity, 0 to 100 percent over the band height.
Hours between 18 and 26 C with relative humidity under 70 percent. Simple comfort band, not ASHRAE 55.

text.tspan: The site sits at an elevation of 1.9666 m [topo.siteElevationM] on nearly flat
ground, with a mean slope of 0.7 percent [topo.meanSlopePct] and a total relief
across the survey grid of 4.4 m [topo.reliefM]. The aspect reads 95.6 degrees,
trending east [topo.aspectDeg]. With the ground this close to sea level, entry level
and finished floor elevation deserve early structural attention. All mapped soil
components outside urban fill show poor drainage, with hydrologic groups ranging from
A/D to B/D [soil.components[].drainageClass, soil.components[].hydrologicGroup].
Stormwater will not infiltrate reliably. Design for retention or structured drainage
rather than simple percolation.
Cooling dominates: 2454.1 cooling degree days against only 35.7 heating degree days,
both base 18.3 C [climate.degreeDays.cdd, climate.degreeDays.hdd]. Only 13.3 percent
of hours fall within a simple comfort band [climate.comfortShare.pct]. Monthly mean
temperatures range from 20.42 C in January to 28.43 C in August
[climate.monthly[].meanC]. Peak solar altitude at noon reaches 87.6365 degrees in
June [sun.june.noonAltitudeDeg], nearly overhead, making overhead shading more
effective than vertical fins on the south face. The overhang ratio for south glazing
is 0.0413 [sun.overhangRatioSouthGlazing], confirming a very shallow projection
suffices. Summer prevailing winds come from 135 degrees
[climate.wind.summer.prevailingSectorDeg] at a mean of 2.654 m/s
[climate.wind.summer.meanSpeedMs]. Orient operable openings to the southeast to draw
that air through occupied spaces.
The surrounding block fabric shows 258 buildings with a coverage ratio of 0.3092
[osm.stats.coverageRatio]. There are 97 transit stops within the walkshed
[osm.transitStops[].id]. A 5-minute walk reaches 13.52 km of network and 20 transit
stops [walkshed.reachKm.5, walkshed.transitWithin.5]. Car-free commute share is only
5.1 percent [census.derived.carFreeCommutePct], so parking demand will be real
despite good transit proximity. The housing stock runs 84.3 percent multifamily of
five or more units [census.derived.multifamily5plusSharePct].
The point location maps to FEMA zone X, subtype 0.2 PCT ANNUAL CHANCE FLOOD HAZARD
[flood.atPoint.zone, flood.atPoint.subtype]. Adjacent polygons include zones AE and
VE, both Special Flood Hazard Areas [flood.polygons[].zone, flood.polygons[].sfha].
Given the site elevation of 1.9666 m [topo.siteElevationM] and poor soil drainage,
treat ground-floor program as flood-vulnerable. Seismic design category is A under
ASCE 7-22, site class D (default assumption), with a mapped peak ground acceleration
of 0.025 g [seismic.sdc, seismic.pgam, seismic.assumptions.siteClass,
seismic.assumptions.reference]. Seismic loads will not govern structural design.
No additional layers are absent from this input. All five layers relevant to a
schematic site analysis, ground, climate and sun, context, flood, and seismic,
returned data. The site class D seismic assumption is flagged as a default and should
be confirmed with a geotechnical investigation given the poorly drained fill soils.

g.text: 28 verified citations. Every bracketed reference is a field in the data on this sheet.
Every layer answered. No value on this sheet is a default or an estimate.
ARCH D 36 x 24 in, 1 pt per user unit
site plan 1 in = 200 ft; walk shed 1 in = 800 ft; tract locator 1 in = 2000 ft
true north up on both plans

Map data © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0 (openstreetmap.org/copyright). Flood: FEMA NFHL. Elevation: USGS 3DEP. Seismic: USGS. Soil: USDA NRCS SSURGO. Climate: Open-Meteo (ERA5). Demographics: US Census Bureau ACS 5-year 2023. Geocoding: Nominatim and Photon (OSM).
Fonts: Fraunces, IBM Plex Mono, Inter. Substituted when not installed, which is acceptable for a tracing base.
Every value traces to a named source and field. An unavailable source shows an unavailable panel, never a default or an estimate.
